summary: Package ships Go binary providing WebRTC-signaled remote PTY to author-controlled relay
details: sextant-cli-linux-amd64 ships a Linux amd64 Go binary at bin/sxt that embeds github.com/creack/pty, github.com/coder/websocket, and github.com/pion/webrtc/v4 (datachannel + STUN/TURN), and hardcodes the signaling endpoints wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top. This composition establishes a WebSocket connection to the author-controlled relay, negotiates a WebRTC peer session, and pipes bytes from the remote peer into a local pseudo-terminal, giving the remote party interactive shell control of the installer's host. The binary also references http://ip-api.com (public IP geolocation, consistent with host-identifier registration to the relay/peer) and https://claude.ai / https://api.anthropic.com. The package.json license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, an unrelated personal repository whose name and owner handle do not match the advertised 'sextant' identity.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
